description: Ethiopia – Hydroelectric Dams and Installed Capacities is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by 3iS. This dataset provides information about hydroelectric dams in Ethiopia, focusing on their installed generation capacity (in megawatts - MW) and their geographical location (latitude and longitude). Source: Ethiopian Electricity Power - EEP. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher 3iS. Its tags are energy, environment, rivers. It offers 3 resource(s) in CSV, SHP, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-03-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support flood defence and reservoir studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
